主要内容: The document titled '6-K' is a report filed by the Royal Bank of Canada with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on March 1, 2012. It is a Form 6-K filing, which is used by foreign private issuers to report information to the SEC. The report includes a section titled 'Exhibit Index' with a description of Exhibit 99.1, which is the 'Royal Bank of Canada – Report of Voting Results.' The filing indicates that the bank is submitting the report in electronic format, as it is not submitting it in paper form. The report is signed by Carol J. McNamara, who holds the title of Vice-President, Associate General Counsel & Secretary. The filing is part of the bank's compliance with U.S. securities regulations.
